summary: This Form 6-K filed by ParaZero Technologies Ltd., a foreign private issuer, reports receipt of an additional order for its DefendAir Net Pod system from a second business unit of a Tier-1 Israeli-based global defense company. The order includes net pods and engineering integration support for autonomous ground Counter-UAS platforms. No financial terms (value, price per share, premium) are disclosed. The press release highlights the growing demand for kinetic interception capabilities in defense systems. This is a routine business development announcement, not a special situation transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, or going-private. The filing updates the market on operational progress in ParaZero's defense product line.
